Part 12 - S-100 Maintenance Procedures 
1 
12-1 
Scope 
As users begin to implement S-100 and associated Product Specifications, errors and deficiencies in 
S-100 may be found and these will need to be handled in a uniform manner. This Part specifies 
procedures to be followed in updating, maintaining and publishing the various parts of S-100.  It 
excludes the maintenance of the IHO Geospatial Information (GI) Registry, as each Register Manager 
will have their own specific procedures for updating their Register(s).  Additionally, this Part excludes 
the maintenance regime of Product Specifications.  However, S-100 versions must be backward 
compatible to ensure interoperability of Product Specifications. 
NOTE: All S-100 based Product Specifications shall include a maintenance section. 
 
12-2 
Maintenance Procedures 
Change proposals for S-100 are coordinated by S-100WG and shall be made available via the IHO 
web site.  Organizations that wish to make changes to S-100 must address their change proposals to 
the IHO Secretariat.   
Changes to S-100 are classified at one of three different levels: new edition, revision, or clarification. 
In each case, the development, consultation and approval process will be slightly different, ranging 
from a very comprehensive regime for new editions, to approval at the level of a subordinate body for 
clarifications. New editions and revisions are considered to be “significant changes” for the purposes 
of review, consultation and approval. 
All proposed changes shall be technically and commercially assessed before approval. All proposals 
must be submitted to the Secretary of the S-100WG using the S-100 Maintenance - Change Proposal 
Form, which is available in the “Help & Guidance” section of the IHO Geospatial Information Registry. 
Changes to IHO technical standard S-100 shall be subject to the terms of Resolution 2/2007. 
 
12-2.1 
Clarification 
Clarifications are non-substantive changes to S-100. Typically, clarifications: remove ambiguity; 
correct grammatical and spelling errors; amend or update cross references; insert improved graphics 
in spelling, punctuation and grammar. A clarification must not cause any substantive semantic change 
to S-100. Clarifications are the responsibility of the relevant subordinate body and may be delegated 
to the responsible editor. 
 
12-2.2 
Revision 
Revisions are defined as substantive semantic changes to S-100. Typically, revisions change existing 
specifications to correct factual errors; introduce necessary changes that have become evident as a 
result of practical experience or changing circumstances; or add new specifications within an existing 
section. Revisions could have an impact on either existing users or future users of a revised standard. 
It follows that a full consultative process that provides an opportunity for input from as many 
stakeholders as possible is required. Proposed changes to S-100 should be evaluated and tested 
wherever practicable. The approval of Member States is required before any revisions to S-100 can 
enter into force. All cumulative clarifications must be included with the release of approved corrections 
revisions. 
A revision shall not be classified as a clarification in order to bypass the appropriate consultation 
processes. 
   
12-2.3 
New Edition 
New Editions of S-100 introduce significant changes. New Editions enable new concepts, such as the 
ability to support new functions or applications, or the introduction of new constructs or data types, to 
be introduced. New Editions are likely to have a significant impact on either existing users or future

pages.chinese:
12-1 范围

随着用户开始实施S-100及相关产品规范,S- 100中的错误和缺陷可能会被找到,需要统一处理,这一部分规定了更新、维护和发布S- 100.100各部分时应遵循的程序。 该系统不包括国际海道测量组织地理空间信息注册簿的维护,因为每个注册簿管理员都有自己更新其注册簿的具体程序,此外,本部分不包括产品规范的维护制度,但S-100版本必须落后相容,以确保产品规范互通。

注:所有S-100产品规范必须包括维修部分。

12-2 维护程序

S-100的修改建议由S-100工作组协调,并将通过国际海道测量组织网站提供,希望修改S-100的组织必须向国际海道测量组织秘书处提出修改建议。

S-100的修改分为三个不同级别:新版、修订版或澄清。 在每个方面,开发、协商和批准程序将略有不同,从对新版的非常全面的制度到对澄清的下属机构的核准。 为了审查、协商和核准的目的,新版本和订正被视为“重大改动”。

所有提议的修改在批准前都必须进行技术和商业评估,所有提案都必须使用国际海道测量组织地理空间信息登记册“帮助和指导”部分提供的S-100维护-修改提案表提交S- 100工作组秘书。

对国际海道测量组织技术标准S-100的修改应符合第2/2007号决议的规定。

122.1 澄清

澄清是对S-100的非实质性修改,一般情况下,澄清:去除模糊;正确的语法和拼写错误;修正或更新交叉引用;在拼写、通体和语法中插入改进后图形;澄清不得导致S- 100的任何实质性语义修改;澄清是相关下属机构的责任,可委托负责编辑。

122.2 订正

修订的定义是S-100的实质性语义修改;通常,修订修改了现有规格,以纠正事实错误;引入了因实践经验或情况变化而明显可见的必要修改;或者在现有一节中添加了新的规格;修订可能会对订正标准的现有用户或未来用户产生影响。 因此,需要有一个充分协商进程,为尽可能多的利益攸关方提供投入提供机会;在可行的情况下,应评价和测试对S-100的拟议修改;在对S -- 100的任何修订生效之前,必须获得会员国的批准;所有累积澄清都必须包括已核准的更正修订。

修订不得被归类为澄清,以绕过适当的磋商程序。

12 2.3 新版

S-100新版引入了显著的改变。新版启用了新概念,例如支持新功能或应用程序的能力,或者引入了新构造或数据类型。新版本可能会对现有用户或未来产生重大影响。

12-3 
Version Control 
The IHO shall release new versions of S-100 as necessary.  New versions shall include clarifications, 
revisions and new editions.  Each version shall contain a change list that identifies the changes 
between versions of S-100. 
 
12-3.1 
Clarification Version Control 
Clarifications shall be denoted as n.n.n.  Each clarification or set of clarifications approved at a single 
point in time shall increment n by 1. 
 
12-3.2 
Revision Version Control 
Revisions shall be denoted as n.n.0.  Each revision or set of revisions approved at a single point in 
time shall increment n by 1.  Revision version control shall set clarification version control to 0. 
 
12-3.3 
New Edition Version Control 
New Editions shall be denoted as n.0.0.  Each new edition approved at a single point in time shall 
increment n by 1.  New Edition version control shall set the clarification and revision version control to 
0.

All cumulative clarifications and revisions must be included with the release of an approved New Edition of S-100.

blocks.english: 12-3 Version Control
blocks.chinese: 12-3 版本控制

blocks.english: The IHO shall release new versions of S-100 as necessary. New versions shall include clarifications, revisions and new editions. Each version shall contain a change list that identifies the changes between versions of S-100.
blocks.chinese: 国际水道测量组织将视需要发布S-100的新版本,新版本必须包括澄清、修订和新版本,每个版本必须包含一份更改清单,标明S- 100版本之间的改动。

blocks.english: 12-3.1 Clarification Version Control
blocks.chinese: 123.1 澄清版本控制

blocks.english: Clarifications shall be denoted as n.n.n. Each clarification or set of clarifications approved at a single point in time shall increment n by 1.
blocks.chinese: 澄清应以n.n.表示。 在单一时间点核准的每一项澄清或一套澄清应增加n 1。

blocks.english: 12-3.2 Revision Version Control
blocks.chinese: 123.2 修订版本控制

blocks.english: Revisions shall be denoted as n.n.0. Each revision or set of revisions approved at a single point in time shall increment n by 1. Revision version control shall set clarification version control to 0.
blocks.chinese: 修订应指:n.0。 在单一时间点核准的每一份修订或每一套修订应增加n 1. 修订版本控制必须将澄清版本控制设为0。

blocks.english: 12-3.3 New Edition Version Control
blocks.chinese: 123.3 新版版本控制

blocks.english: New Editions shall be denoted as n.0.0. Each new edition approved at a single point in time shall increment n by 1. New Edition version control shall set the clarification and revision version control to 0.
blocks.chinese: 新版应指:n.0.0。在单一时间点上批准的每份新版应递增n 1. 新版版本控制应规定澄清和修订版本控制为0。

因此,需要有一个充分的磋商进程,为尽可能多的利益攸关方提供投入提供机会。只要可行,就应对S-100的拟议修改进行评估和测试。 所有累计澄清和修改必须随S-100新版批准发行而列入.

12-3 版本控制

国际水道测量组织将视需要发布S-100的新版本,新版本必须包括澄清、修订和新版本,每个版本必须包含一份更改清单,标明S- 100版本之间的改动。

123.1 澄清版本控制

澄清应以n.n.表示。 在单一时间点核准的每一项澄清或一套澄清应增加n 1。

123.2 修订版本控制

修订应指:n.0。 在单一时间点核准的每一份修订或每一套修订应增加n 1. 修订版本控制必须将澄清版本控制设为0。

123.3 新版版本控制

新版应指:n.0.0。在单一时间点上批准的每份新版应递增n 1. 新版版本控制应规定澄清和修订版本控制为0。
